other_failure_modes.name: Target transformation metric mismatch
other_failure_modes.description: The agent trains all models on a log-transformed target, which effectively optimizes for RMSLE. However, the final evaluation metric is RMSE on the original scale. Because RMSE heavily penalizes large absolute errors on extreme values, transforming predictions back via `expm1` without bias correction results in severe underprediction of large values and suboptimal RMSE performance.

summary: The agent implements a highly rigorous machine learning pipeline with excellent out-of-fold feature engineering, deep learning integration, and ensemble optimization. However, it fails to account for the temporal nature of the dataset during splitting, and it introduces a severe metric mismatch by training models on a log-transformed target while evaluating on raw RMSE, which will heavily penalize the inevitable underprediction of large contract amounts.
